-- InterfaceController  (Controller — client)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local InterfaceController = {}
InterfaceController.Priority = 0

function InterfaceController:Start(c)
	local Context = c._runtime
	local player  = Players.LocalPlayer

	local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screen.Name = "Interface"; screen.ResetOnSpawn = false; screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling; screen.DisplayOrder = 20
	screen.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	-- load every _Class into a lookup (Theme/Base/Button/Toggle/…)
	local Classes = {}
	for _, mod in script._Classes:GetChildren() do
		if mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local m = require(mod)
			if mod.Name ~= "Theme" and mod.Name ~= "Base" and type(m) ~= "function" then
				warn(`[Interface] class '{mod.Name}' should return a function, got {type(m)}`)
			end
			Classes[mod.Name] = m
		end
	end

	-- the context injected into every element (mirrors what the Bootstrap gives controllers)
	local ctx = {
		Packages  = Context.Packages,
		Utilities = Context.Utilities,
		Services = Context.Modules,
		Classes   = Classes,
		Theme     = Classes.Theme,
		Screen    = screen,
		Player    = player,
	}

	-- boot every _Element: require it, call :Start(ctx), collect its root
	local elements = {}
	for _, mod in script._Elements:GetChildren() do
		if mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local el = require(mod)
			ctx.Source = mod.Name
			local ok, root = pcall(function() return el.Start and el:Start(ctx) or nil end)
			if not ok then warn(`[Interface] {mod.Name}:Start errored: {root}`) end
			elements[mod.Name] = { module = el, root = ok and root or nil, visible = false }
			if elements[mod.Name].root then elements[mod.Name].root.Visible = false end
		end
	end

	-- minimal topbar: one button per element, opens it (others close)
	local C = Classes.Theme.Color
	local bar = Classes.Base.new("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 40),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0) }, screen)
	Classes.Base.list(bar, true, 8, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center)
	local function open(name)
		for n, e in elements do if e.root then e.root.Visible = (n == name and not e.visible); e.visible = e.root.Visible end end
	end
	local i = 0
	for name, e in elements do
		i += 1
		Classes.Button({ Text = name, Variant = "secondary", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 36),
			LayoutOrder = i, OnClick = function() open(name) end, Parent = bar })
	end

	c:OnCleanup(function() screen:Destroy() end)
end

return InterfaceController
